notes.title: DodgeKill is now in Early Access !
notes.notes: [h2]The game is now available for purchase ![/h2][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3113950/DodgeKill/" style="button"]Store Page[/url][/p][h3]Can you survive until the end ?[/h3][p]Enjoy a dynamic game that won't let your rest! 7 levels await you in this first Early Access, and will put your nerves to the test! And if that's not enough for you, challenges await you after each level. Will you have the courage to increase the difficulty?[/p][p][/p][h3]A game accessible to all![/h3][p]Keyboard, controller or even touch screens, if you don't have a mouse, the game can be played with any other controller![/p][p]Accessibility settings are also available :[/p][list][*][p]Special palettes for color blind people[/p][/*][*][p]Camera movement and vibration strength settings[/p][/*][*][p]Disable rhythm effects and background movements[/p][/*][/list][h3]Warning[/h3][p]Event will accessibility settings, [i]DodgeKill[/i] remains [b]not recommended for photosensitive or epileptic people![/b] For the most eye-friendly game experience, turn on the Monochromatic mode and turn off every effect! On the other hand, it will turn off any color on every levels for a common Black & White color palette, you will therefore not benefit from the colors originally planned.[/p]

notes.title: Demo v7
notes.notes: [p]Small update for the demo :[/p][list][*][p]The game now pauses when :[/p][list][*][p]The current used controller is unplugged / disconnects / isn't detected anymore[/p][/*][*][p]The steam overlay opens[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v6
notes.notes: [p]Small update for the demo :[/p][list][*][p]Based on player feedback : The player doubles in size when having the bonus to reduce the precision needed[/p][/*][*][p]Little bug fixed with the animation of health gain[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v5
notes.notes: [p]Small update for the demo based on player feedback :[/p][list][*][p]The setting "Floating HUD" is now turned on by default for new players[/p][list][*][p]This setting makes your interface float around your cursor to be readable without using your peripheral vision[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The first bonus that appears in a game will now show a small floating text "Grab me !" to make players understand they need to take it[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v4
notes.notes: [p]Small update for the demo :[/p][list][*][p]Added 0.75s of invincibilité after the bonus ends[/p][/*][*][p]The main menu now fades in[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo v3
notes.notes: [p]Small update for the demo :[/p][list][*][p]Sound volume setting bug fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Trappers and the Mega Trapper do not drop bombs / enemies anymore when the player is dead to reduce lags[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Participation in the Steam Next Fest !
notes.notes: [h3]A demo [b]update[/b] is available for the occasion![/h3][p][/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]An improved combo counter[/p][/*][*][p]A new life gain animation[/p][/*][*][p]Several crashs and bugs fixed here and there[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Feel free to try the game and give us as much feedback as possible; we can't wait to see what you think![/p]
